selection: Frozen CODATA 2022 direct muon/electron ratio and electron energy; PDG 2024 tau average. Retrospective comparison, not a prospective test.

muon_electron_ratio.role: comparison only; published direct ratio includes its adjustment uncertainty

electron_MeV.role: reference denominator and optional calibrated energy display only

tau_MeV.edition: S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024)

covariance.availability: These selected primary tables provide marginal uncertainties, not a cross-edition joint covariance for the two comparison ratios. No zero covariance or joint likelihood is assumed.
